title: Measure real Core Web Vitals on a clean profile for the public pages: JS looks like 2 to 3.5 MB encoded per page

source.ref: Whole-site audit 2026-11-16 (project thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: PLAUSIBLE. Audit file: audit/FINAL-BUILD-AND-REPAIR-LIST-2026-11-16.md

detail:
EVIDENCE: Daniel signed-in Chrome, same-origin iframe at 390 px, 2026-11-16, warm cache: TTFB 120 to 190 ms (good); CLS 0.000 on /pricing, /the-community, /for/studios, /discover, /themes; script bytes 2,150 / 2,097 / 2,703 / 2,097 / 3,478 KB, images 105 to 324 KB except /themes at 1,024 KB; 82 to 129 requests per page. LCP not captured. A signed-in shell and a warm cache can distort script bytes. Layout at 390, 1280, 1440, 1920, 2000 across 8 pages: no horizontal scroll anywhere; one h1 each.

WHY IT MATTERS: If the script weight holds on a clean first visit, phones on cell data in North County pay for it on every landing page, and it would show in search ranking and signup. We have no recorded baseline.

FIX DIRECTION: Run Lighthouse mobile and desktop plus field data (Vercel Speed Insights) on the ten top landing pages from a clean profile; write docs/perf/public-cwv-baseline.md; then cut by evidence.

NOT MEASURED 2026-11-16, row stays open. The agent sandbox cannot reach https://frequencylocal.com: the outbound proxy refuses the connection (CONNECT tunnel failed, 403, a host policy denial), so no clean-profile reading of the production pages was possible from there and docs/perf/public-cwv-baseline.md was not written. No number was invented. The nearest real readings are lab runs against Vercel previews, not production: lighthouse job on 2026-11-04 to 11-06 (jobs 128040514401, 128049408624, 128084620428), phone emulation, median of 3: / LCP 4755 to 4968 ms, TBT 194 to 427 ms, CLS 0.000; /feed signed out LCP 6250 to 6324 ms, TBT 114 to 219 ms, CLS 0.000, script transfer 728 KB. Those are recorded in lighthouserc.mobile.json (SCAN-1234). They say phone LCP is well over the 2000 ms marketing field budget in the lab and that script transfer on the member shell read 0.7 MB over the wire on a clean signed-out load, against the 2.1 to 3.5 MB read in the signed-in browser above; the two were not measured the same way, so that gap is a lead, not a finding. To finish: run the measurement from a machine that can reach the site, or allow the host for the sandbox.

verify.note: Fails on 2026-11-16 (audit run). Passes when the fix lands. Audit-written probes are direction checks; retime only with Daniel's phrase.
